knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)
library(bslib)

global_raw <- read_csv(
  "Brianna/estimated_number_of_malaria_cases_2000-2015.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

europe_raw <- read_csv(
  "Brianna/estimated_number_of_WHO_europe_malaria_cases_2000-2015.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

global_cases <- global_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = Location,
    year = as.integer(Period),
    cases = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2015)

europe_cases <- europe_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = country,
    year = as.integer(year),
    cases = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2015)

global_trend <- global_cases %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    countries_with_data = sum(!is.na(cases)),
    cases = if (all(is.na(cases))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

europe_trend <- europe_cases %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    countries_with_data = sum(!is.na(cases)),
    cases = if (all(is.na(cases))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

world <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = if_else(iso_a3 == "-99", adm0_a3, iso_a3)
  ) %>%
  select(iso3, name, geometry)

europe_iso3 <- c(
  "ALB", "AND", "ARM", "AUT", "AZE", "BLR", "BEL",
  "BIH", "BGR", "HRV", "CYP", "CZE", "DNK", "EST",
  "FIN", "FRA", "GEO", "DEU", "GRC", "HUN", "ISL",
  "IRL", "ISR", "ITA", "KAZ", "KGZ", "LVA", "LTU",
  "LUX", "MLT", "MCO", "MNE", "NLD", "MKD", "NOR",
  "POL", "PRT", "MDA", "ROU", "RUS", "SMR", "SRB",
  "SVK", "SVN", "ESP", "SWE", "CHE", "TJK", "TUR",
  "TKM", "UKR", "GBR", "UZB"
)

case_palette <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c(
    "#21113D",
    "#63318E",
    "#B536A0",
    "#F15BB5",
    "#FFD166"
  ),
  domain = europe_cases$cases,
  na.color = "#30303A"
)
```

```{r map-functions}

make_map_data <- function(selected_year) {

  world %>%
    filter(iso3 %in% europe_iso3) %>%
    left_join(
      europe_cases %>%
        filter(year == as.integer(selected_year)),
      by = "iso3"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      is_azerbaijan = iso3 == "AZE"
    )
}

draw_malaria_map <- function(selected_year) {

  map_data <- make_map_data(selected_year)

  leaflet(
    map_data,
    options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    setView(lng = 35, lat = 48, zoom = 3) %>%

    addPolygons(
      group = "country-polygons",
      layerId = ~iso3,
      fillColor = ~case_palette(cases),
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      color = ~ifelse(is_azerbaijan, "#FF3CAC", "#55515F"),
      weight = ~ifelse(is_azerbaijan, 4, 0.8),

      label = ~paste0(
        name,
        ifelse(is_azerbaijan, " ★ FOCUS COUNTRY", ""),
        ": ",
        ifelse(
          is.na(cases),
          "No estimate available",
          format(round(cases), big.mark = ",")
        ),
        "Estimated Cases"
      ),

      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 4,
        color = "#FFD166",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%

    addLabelOnlyMarkers(
      data = sf::st_point_on_surface(
        map_data %>% filter(is_azerbaijan)
      ),
      label = ~"AZERBAIJAN",
      labelOptions = labelOptions(
        noHide = TRUE,
        direction = "top",
        textOnly = TRUE,
        style = list(
          "color" = "#FF3CAC",
          "font-weight" = "bold",
          "font-size" = "12px",
          "text-shadow" = "0 0 5px #000000"
        )
      )
    ) %>%

    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = case_palette,
      values = europe_cases$cases,
      title = "Estimated Cases",
      na.label = "No estimate"
    )
}
```

```{r graph-functions}

graph_theme <- function() {

  theme_minimal() +

    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "#F5F5F7"),

      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = "#111118",
        color = NA
      ),

      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = "#111118",
        color = NA
      ),

      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        color = "#30243F"
      ),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      axis.text = element_text(
        color = "#D9CDE8"
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        color = "#D9CDE8"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        color = "#FF3CAC",
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        color = "#B9B1C9"
      )
    )
}
```

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  output$malaria_map <- renderLeaflet({

    draw_malaria_map(input$year)

  })

  observeEvent(input$year, {

    map_data <- make_map_data(input$year)

    leafletProxy(
      "malaria_map",
      data = map_data
    ) %>%

      clearGroup("country-polygons") %>%

      addPolygons(
        group = "country-polygons",
        layerId = ~iso3,

        fillColor = ~case_palette(cases),
        fillOpacity = 0.9,

        color = ~ifelse(
          is_azerbaijan,
          "#FF3CAC",
          "#55515F"
        ),

        weight = ~ifelse(
          is_azerbaijan,
          4,
          0.8
        ),

        label = ~paste0(
          name,
          ifelse(is_azerbaijan, " ★ FOCUS COUNTRY", ""),
          ": ",
          ifelse(
            is.na(cases),
            "No estimate available",
            format(round(cases), big.mark = ",")
          ),
          " Estimated Cases"
        ),

        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
          weight = 4,
          color = "#FFD166",
          bringToFront = TRUE
        )
      )

  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  output$global_trend <- renderPlot({

    ggplot(
      global_trend,
      aes(x = year, y = cases)
    ) +

      geom_line(
        color = "#B536A0",
        linewidth = 1.2
      ) +

      geom_point(
        color = "#FF3CAC",
        size = 2
      ) +

      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = 2000:2015
      ) +

      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = function(x) {
          format(
            x,
            big.mark = ",",
            scientific = FALSE
          )
        }
      ) +

      labs(
        title = "Available Global Malaria Estimates",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Estimated Cases"
      ) +

      graph_theme()

  })

  output$europe_trend <- renderPlot({

    ggplot(
      europe_trend,
      aes(x = year, y = cases)
    ) +

      geom_line(
        color = "#FF3CAC",
        linewidth = 1.2
      ) +

      geom_point(
        color = "#FFD166",
        size = 2
      ) +

      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = 2000:2015
      ) +

      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = function(x) {
          format(
            x,
            big.mark = ",",
            scientific = FALSE
          )
        }
      ) +

      labs(
        title = "WHO European Region Malaria Estimates",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Estimated Cases"
      ) +

      graph_theme()

  })

  output$azerbaijan_summary <- renderUI({

    az <- europe_cases %>%
      filter(
        iso3 == "AZE",
        year == as.integer(input$year)
      )

    if (nrow(az) == 0 || is.na(az$cases[1])) {

      return(
        p("No estimate available for this year.")
      )

    }

    tagList(

      h4(
        "AZERBAIJAN",
        style = "color:#FF3CAC;"
      ),

      h2(
        format(
          round(az$cases[1]),
          big.mark = ","
        ),
        style = "color:#FFD166;"
      ),

      p("Estimated Malaria Cases"),

      p(
        paste(
          "Selected year:",
          input$year
        )
      )
    )

  })

  output$az_trend <- renderPlot({

    az <- europe_cases %>%
      filter(iso3 == "AZE") %>%
      arrange(year)

    ggplot(
      az,
      aes(x = year, y = cases)
    ) +

      geom_line(
        color = "#FF3CAC",
        linewidth = 1.2
      ) +

      geom_point(
        color = "#FFD166",
        size = 2
      ) +

      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = 2000:2015
      ) +

      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = function(x) {
          format(
            x,
            big.mark = ",",
            scientific = FALSE
          )
        }
      ) +

      labs(
        title = "Azerbaijan: Estimated Cases",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Estimated Cases"
      ) +

      graph_theme()

  })

}

shinyApp(
  ui = ui,
  server = server
)
